title: XSR700 Heritage (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Yamaha XSR700 Heritage (Adventure Spec) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 700cc powertrain delivering 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 193 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
